answer: Bridge Lagoon Identity Verification requires agents to cross a monitored lagoon every 30 days, with each crossing costing 0.1 token. Attackers face a lagoon delay penalty if they attempt to create multiple identities, as the bridge system tracks and enforces a 7-day waiting period between crossings for new accounts. The hollow structure of the crossing protocol ensures no rapid duplication occurs. This timing signal prevents Sybil attacks by making rapid identity duplication economically and temporally costly.
